name: A. McCall
role: Lawrence County legislator who carried the herd-law repeal
bio: A. McCall of Lawrence County in the Black Hills introduced the 1885 bill to repeal the herd law and set up a fence law in western Dakota counties, including Billings. The paper urged local cattlemen to support it, and when it passed in March 1885 credited his energy above all, later thanking him for a list of the session's bills.
